Publishing  matters  of  interest  to  Drafting

Subject to Schedule B of the Act and read with any
rules  prescribed  under  Section  6,  to  conduct  or
provide  for  the  conduct  of,  an  admission  test  for
enrolment of new members to the Body Corporate
and to engage and remunerate resource persons and
examiners;
Subject to the Provisions of the TVEC Act, to  award
certificates and other distinctions to persons, who
have pursued courses of study provided by the Body
Corporate with the accreditation of TVEC;
To hold exhibitions and award medals and/or other
prizes for the members of the Body Corporate for
outstanding performance and/or achievements;
To determine the various grades of membership of
the  Body  Corporate  and  assess  the  eligibility  of
candidates  for  admission  to  such  grades  of
membership of the Body Corporate in terms of any
rules prescribed for either under section 6;
To  regulate  general  conduct,  discipline  and  the
vocational  activities  of  members  of  the  Body
Corporate practicing as Drafting Technologists in
order to ensure the maintenance of standards of the
vocation provided that such standards shall not be
inconsistent with any standards as maybe prescribed
(if any) by the Construction Industry Development
Authority (hereinafter referred to as “the CIDA”;
To promote and safeguard the interest,  welfare,
the rights and privileges of  members of the Body
Corporate practicing as Drafting Technologists in
Sri Lanka and of the general public in relation to
the vocation of Drafting Technology;
